{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

Unfortunately, the imps he worked with got one over him and just pounded the bell on his head, releasing a ringing noise right into his eardrums. For next year, he's decided to just settle with earmuffs.

At least he didn't forget to bring his mask unlike SOME imbecile. However, he remembered he left the TV on before leaving the house so he needs to go and deal with more important business.

He was ready to lose himself to all the frivolities that come with the new year celebrations, so you could imagine his frustration when he had to go to work and fight plants on new years. But he supposed he couldn't get away with sick leave 3 years in a row. Dr. Zomboss will catch on eventually.

{FLAVOR}This Gargantuar's outfit has been a matter of study for Gargologists all around the globe. Fascinating trinkets of Chinese culture are all over. For example: the symbol on his basket means fortune. In the context of Lunar New Year, putting this symbol upside down like on this specimen conveys that the zombies' hope fortune pours down on them. So essentially, it means to hope for good fortune, in other words, brains. For more fun Gargantuar clothes trivia visit your local Gargologist, symptoms may vary.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: A not-so-intimidating giant when dressed up like this.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage

Clearly he did not do his job well, but this was a deliberate mistake on his part. He wears this outfit everyday and never parts from it. If you are reading this on the year of the sheep, then this imp can be considered the best Lunar organizer to exist.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is thrown onto the lawn past your defenses with a soft impact, then shuffles ahead.

If his years of enlightenment from spiritual retreats, as well as his booming wood processing factory could say anything on the matter, it would be the fact that Money does in fact, grow from trees. The lack of foresight that the people of olden days have displayed regarding the benefits of potential business opportunities created from lumber has always been discrediting for him.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_MONEYTREE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Moneytree Zombies occasionally drop three yuanbaos around them. The yuanbaos can crush plants and block projectiles.

{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His Jolly Roger cone makes him twice as tough as normal pirates.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His sturdy wooden bucket provides excellent protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Barrelhead Zombie's keg-like hat provides augmented protection.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}What could it be? Could it be gold? Or some sort of other kind of treasure?  Who knows!
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Contains Imp Zombies that launch out when destroyed.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}420
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.15

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His parrot can fly away with your plant and then return to him.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_PARROT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}300

Quickly flies from the Captain to carry away a plant.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Enormous zombie who redefines the shark attack.

ZOMBIE_PIRATE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Prefers the compact space of barrels, both cannon and rolling.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}A royal with a strong sense of fashion and originality. He's enjoyed his affluent unlife believing his cone was the best of them all even across time and after crossing into our world, be the best in the multiverse. This belief was shattered the moment he met the Carnie Coneheads.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HE: His magnificent cone provides twice as much wealth in sturdiness compared to those impoverished in armor.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Extremely displeased at the fact that he needs to pour 0.03% of his wealth just to forge and wear protective armor into battle. That financial hole will never, ever be patched up.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HE: His ornate golden bucket provides splendid protection from barbaric attacks.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Determined to keep the influence of his royal house in his homeworld, him and his colleagues happened to stumble upon the Rainbow Market after an unusual turn of events. Luckily for him, he happened to stumble upon Greedy, and shook hands on a deal that would benefit them both. Despite their universal and temporal differences, they both got along quite well, now ready to spread their wealth and influence to our world. The House of Plantagenet shall now live on through universes.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Always groaning about how uncivilized it is for him and his fellow nobles are by charging like a mob towards the plants, thinking it's a step back for their royal image as the House of Plantagenet even if they're already dead. Greedy promptly reminded that zombie that he is but a second-rate noble, and that the godfather knows better.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Marks the arrival of a huge luxurious "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with ladle
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Server Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Said to be a master of cuisine back in his home universe. With dishes so good that everyone in the royal house is craving for more, spending much of their money just for a taste. Now that he's here, he's yearning for competition, and he has his sights set on a certain King of the Grill. Will he cook through the competition or get French fried?
Massive zombie that'll make delicious vegan stew out of your plants.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}At the face of multiple instances of new competition compared to her original dimension, she started to strive to be the best maid. But when your competition is capable of things like sweeping, superb coordination and EVEN flight, not to mention that some of them also serve tea that invigorates zombies more, she's fighting an uphill battle. Now her only real advantage is her strong will to keep up.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Is deployed past your defenses, then serves forward.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_NOBLEWOMAN_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}flings and destroys plants using gusts whipped up by her fan

{FLAVOR}More concerned about the smell of her perfume than anything else. The maids do a good job with her daily get-up. Though she's still blissfully unaware of the fact the maids applied Perfume-shroom scented perfume over her favorite Iris-scented one.
Maiden of magnificence that flings plants away with her state-of-the-art fan.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{FLAVOR}Still looking for an old shoe she lost when she was younger. Has a nagging feeling she accidentally turned it invisible all those years ago. Kids can be quite clumsy after all, royal or not.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION_: Maiden of royalty that blesses her fellow zombies with the gift of invincibility.

{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}slaps plants instead of eating

ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_WINE_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Throws cups of wine towards plants that deal damage and stun them.

ZOMBIE_RA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tries to steal sun, just for safe keeping.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}The sign isn't misplaced, his stupidity is enough to be a workplace hazard but not quite to the point where he'd be fired. Luckily for him, you won't find any replacements this far out.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His stand sign headwear provides him with increased protection.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Construction Buckethead is of the opinion that the buckets from way back in 2013 are increasingly blasé to the average zombie looking for protection. It's time for reinvention, something retro but also modern, something that screams venetian red. He'd go on about it, but there's surprisingly low interest on investing in new buckets in the middle of nowhere.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His paint bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (hourglass) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He's got all the time wasted here on his mind.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His time-appropriate headgear provides great protection.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}gremlins thrown from barrel when destroyed

{FLAVOR}He used to plunder the seas, while wearing a mask to cover his facial features. The mysterious aspect of his impromptu fashion style, as well as his successful pillages, earned him quite a name. He even got invited to a photo shoot. There, he took off his mask and... you can guess what happened next. The editor screamed at the photographer to remove that image, but it was too late. Next thing you know, his face is on all the almanacs everywhere.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His rolling barrel crushes plants, spawns strange imp creatures and provides excellent protection. His face does not.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Compared to some of the other impish construction zombies you may see working in the Time-Space, Construction Zombies like him dabble in much less worldly work, and more in the lines of road work. It's much more mundane, but at least he's got a way to justify the inflated budgets here.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}smashes plants with shovel
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage to other obstacles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks lobbed shots, but is vulnerable to incoming projectiles

{FLAVOR}After the failed expedition in Lost City, he had an epiphany. The tried-and-true method of deploying Parasol Zombies to protect zombies like himself was simply inefficient, predictable, easily defeated. And some of those punk plants have built up the immunity to being shoveled, which is INCREDIBLY rude! He came up with the perfect strategy with his Parasol compatriots: what if they switched their roles, tried out something new with their weapons? They pitched the idea to Zomboss on the way back to Modern Day... and were kicked out of his vehicle, left here in this rift. Maybe Zomboss doesn't get it, but they keep trying to show their strategy to anyone who happens to roam by here. Surely, someone, someday, will see their vision.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shovel provides protection from lobbed projectiles, and can also be used to smash plants.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He always quarrels with architect zombies who provide the flags for him. When asked why, he said that those "Epic Realm" side projects of theirs keep misplacing the construction budget from more important sites.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His flag marks the arrival of a huge work-in-progress "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}He's the lead of the demolition team. If you read his resume submitted to the Braindella company, you might discover why nobody except you remembers Gentleman Zombie wearing a different hat, Explorer Zombie fully engulfed in flames and OSHA certified Toy Car Imps.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Construction Rally Zombie marks the arrival of an eyesore of zombies.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}4200
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12 (normal), 0.4 (enraged)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with tuna
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}becomes enraged when damaged, increasing his speed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}highly resistant to movement impairing effects

{FLAVOR}It runs in the family. You think he got it bad? Wait until you meet Kindergartenerface Gargantuar and Teenagerface Gargantuar.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Babyface Gargantuar is seventy-five percent of a big deal.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGIMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with a 2x4, dealing 7.5 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}He was a prime candidate for some shrink ray experiment called Operation D-S Zombies (short for Dinky-Sized), the end goal was to create a group of portable zombies that would've easily fit into anyone's pockets. Unfortunately, the shrink ray was rife with too many side effects to justify the cost, causing the project's cessation. Gargimp lost his imp along the way and wasn't paid with the gumdrop he was promised. Now he roams the Time-Space smashing things just to pass time. He would've written an autobiography about the whole experience if pens weren't so fun to smash things with.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gargimp is a bit of a small problem.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}These guys are Zomboss's right-hand crew, always around to build the paths in every era. They've been off-duty for a very long time, and only recently got back to work when Zomboss decided to visit Steam Ages. But, now? They're taking a break. The other guys have been hard at work on those Epic Realm projects. They've got some time until Zomboss gets impatient with finishing the rest of their map building. Give 'em a couple more months. You'll be amazed what they can do in such a short time.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is NOT tossed into your defenses, but will still construct a path forward regardless.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_JANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}uses parasol to push plants
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage to other obstacles

{FLAVOR}Being left behind in this rift isn't so bad. Sure, she got an awful berating from Zomboss for going along with "such a stupid, idiotic, quite frankly moronic idea," but she's seen lots of exciting stuff! Witnessing the daily work commutes by ZCorp employees, the construction crews build access roads to new time periods, the daily commute of zombies to Piñata Parties, the beautiful traffic jams of Tumble-Weasels every other Tuesday. But she's also seen a lot of weird stuff. She's pretty sure she saw an entire time period change overnight, into some weird futuristic ship in the sky, specifically after some old guy traveling in a massive robot bird took that exit. The others insist it was always like that, but she's convinced she knows what she saw. Maybe the isolation from zociety is getting to her at this point.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Parasol provides protection from incoming projectiles, and can be used to push plants.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_SNIFFER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}sniffing does no damage, but helps it block shots for other zombies

{FLAVOR}The Sniffer is a fabled being among zombiekind, originating from ancient Atlantian mythology. Some say that the being is simply a project Dr. Zomboss abandoned to create a zombie of great nose, for whatever purpose that would serve. Others, however, insist that The Sniffer originates from an alternate reality, one where the laws and decorum of polite zociety are left behind in favor of lawlessness, absurdity, and utter nautical nonsense. The Sniffer, however, insists that these factions should not engage in war over its origin, for war does not determine who is right, only who is left.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants, dealing 10 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}These Tumble-Weasels are abnormalities in the weasel process. Dr. Zomboss mandates that these must be dumped into the rift, as they are simply too rotund for his liking. Despite being rare, because so many are dropped off here in the rift, they are a nuisance to travelers, often causing traffic jams and accidents as they roll across the highway. It's really bad during holidays.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Soft, rotund specimen that crushes plants as it rolls down the lane.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION: Was there enough traffic in Ancient Rome to justify cones? Historians differ. It's a real debate.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A traffic cone made of marble provides some protection.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION: They had buckets just like this back in Ancient Rome. Believe it.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A fancy bucket with a bit of flair distinguishes this zombie.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION: Did you know that in Ancient Rome, a centurion commanded a century? Isn't that wild?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A higher grade of Roman Zombie.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION: Bust Head Zombie belongs in museum with a big sign that says something like, "WARNING: THIS IS A ZOMBIE!"
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A bust head means this Roman zombie can take a serious beating.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION: Surprise! That exploding vase has a zombie in it! Isn’t that surprising?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A ballista from Ancient Rome, the Zcorpion Zombie launches an exploding vase at the nearest plant in its lane.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION: In Ancient Rome, flags were often used on the battlefield to direct troop movements. Though come on: how much direction do you really need to shuffle leftward?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The flag indicates more zombies are on their way!
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION: He's got a column and he's not afraid to use it.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Wears a helmet. Throws an imp AND a net. Just a real piece of work.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION: Hot tip: take this one out as fast as you can if you don't want your life turned into a pit of abject misery and despair.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Uses weird Roman magic to heal zombies.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION: Like all Zombie Imps, Roman Imp keeps turning up where you least want him.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Small. Impy. Wears a former lion.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION: Hailing originally from Greece but thriving in Rome, Zombie Medusa takes advice from her snakes based on their charisma and shared personal hisssstory.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Zombie Medusa pushes petrified zombies in stone blocks as well as stoneifying zombies and zomboids that face her.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION: The shield protects him from bad reviews and hurtful remarks.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_: A dull-witted, unusually shy Roman zombie who's also carrying a shield.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_PAIR_DESCRIPTION: When three Roman shield zombies are too many, how about two? Two's a good number, right? It's even, it's prime... it's got everything!
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_PAIR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: A pair of Roman shield zombies.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION: This number of shield zombies is three higher than zombies can count.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION_HE: Three Roman shield zombies in a row.
ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.355
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants

{FLAVOR}Seagull Zombie has racked up the frequent flier miles and dreams of going to the top colleges in the world on a cerebral gastronomy vacation.
ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Crosses watery gaps without a plank and flies over low plants.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:

{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Her time keeping cone keeps her well protected, and on time.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Her bucket keeps her well-being and fate well protected.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BELL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}480
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons imp maids around her every once in a while
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}That dreaded ringing. The scourge of maidens and nannies alike.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BELL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Rings her bell, summoning imp maids around her.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BESOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}480
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes plants to the left instead of eating
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage to other obstacles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}Keeping the possessions of Greedy tidy ain't easy. She fears the day his collection gets into theoretical numbers.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BESOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Keeps your lawn tidy by pushing plants with her besom.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BLACK_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

{FLAVOR}Many of her kind were lost trying to dig out Greedy's loose change from between the couch cushions.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_BLACK_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The smallest cleaning service you could ever call on.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

The imp pilots choose to wear a stylish gas mask in honor of the zombie who put them in the position to create havoc. They say it creates a sense of comradery amongst the zombies, but that sense is quickly undermined by all the "passing gas" jokes made by their colleagues.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GAS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gas Pod Imps drop in above the skies uninvited and, once ready, periodically unleash deadly doses of gas in an area.

{FLAVOR}All imp pilots driving these heavy duty weapons share a penchant for senseless destruction, it's practically a requirement. They are also practicing rocket surgeons, an actual requirement needed to operate and operate on these missiles.
If not defeated in time, fires a missile that deals massive damage to the house.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}The all new Pelican-1 Aircraft was designed to protect all contents within, with an impressive carrying capacity of about 3,000 imps, an ergonomic seat and cup holders, it's no wonder it's currently the bleeding edge when it comes to pelican-based zombie carriers. No matter how much those salty sea dogs try to dispute it, at the very least this behemoth doesn't have to worry about some butter putting a quick stop to its delivery.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Flies in to drop off a payload of Paratrooper Imps.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200 + 500 (force field)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates a spammable shield to protect from incoming attacks

The ZACU Protector is an energy field manipulator that is able to outmatch whatever Zomboss thinks he has in the year 2323! All it took is some stolen blueprints and a bounty's worth of depleted uranium-235 as it's fuel source. Just don't ask what the conduit tube attached to the helmet is for when you're going to drive this thing, it's highly confidential and the answer is not pretty.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Creates weaker shields, but regenerates them more often.

His ideal soldier is to be trained in a specialized boot camp, in addition to being provided with several action movie flicks and of course, a rocket launcher for good measure. All bases had to be covered when it comes getting first blood in this battlefield.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ROCKET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A zombie with big guns toting a big gun.

Dr. Zomboss obsessed over every detail of the aquatic mechanism of doom as he worked on it day in and day out from the wee hours of the morning until well after dark. He carefully handcrafted the shark's nearly impenetrable exterior skin. He shaved each razor-sharp tooth to a point by hand. And he painstakingly installed the lethal plant-consuming fan inside the machine's horrific maw all by himself. Zomboss shed more than one tear of joy when his masterpiece was complete. Say what you will about the evil genius, but he is passionate about his projects.

Not long after the tune finished, his expression soured. "It's rigged! Those plants are cheaters, the lot of them! Why, if I didn't take over the carnival, so many wonders would have been left unearthed. I deserve to have that toybox!"

The Queen, however, laughs, thinking to herself how clueless the crazed mad scientist could be to be so easily puppeteered. A dream where the people she has grown to hate the most fight until they can no longer dream. A nightmare they cannot wake up from. Unfortunately, the tale could not end the way she wanted it to. With the beast slain, the queen retreated in solitude. Wandering around as the remaining days of her unlife keep flashing before her eyes. What's left is the same yearning for the past the former queen has always wanted, now devoid of the star she was once illuminated by. The times when she could still smile. When she was still happy.

ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE2_DESCRIPTION_H: The mammoth mech with an ice blast from the past, invigorated by the cold of overdue revenge.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss was real impressed with himself when he came up with the idea to build a weaponized woolly mammoth with the power to blast snow and ice out of its mechanical trunk. But what Dr. Zomboss didn’t realize until it was too late: He’s allergic to mammoth fur. Now he has to load up on allergy medication every time he wants to take the darn thing out for a spin.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION_HE: The mammoth mech with an ice blast from the past.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops zombies and bags o’ sand

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss' latest creation involved the implementation of aspects belonging to ancient civilizations, without understanding their historical meaning. Asked in a post-fight interview, Dr. Zomboss stated that he does not care and that it was essential to the machine's look, and shoo'd the press away. Needless to say, these statements are not helping his public image.
The floating fortress from the sky above, ascending once more to take on the challenge.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops zombies and bags o’ sand

{FLAVOR}After repeated failures with variously robotic engines of destruction, Dr. Zomboss decided to go with a kinder, more eco-friendly lighter-than-air option to sow disaster and discord.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION_: The floating fortress from the skies above.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^8600CC^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}leaf blower blows away plants and pushes zombies forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires a tommy gun at plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spawns market cards and maid tables

{FLAVOR}Programming this machine was quite a chore. One bug denied any attempts at subtracting values from Klepto-maton's variables, another one made all pointers refer to themselves, and the script broke the binary system once, with the error log showing "Numbers 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are mine!"
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION_HE: A sophisticated machine of avarice, expendable for nefarious means.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MODERN1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates fireballs and iceballs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}opens portals

{FLAVOR}Truth be told, Dr. Zomboss really can't help but miss the good old days. How he used to terrorize the neighborhood with his giant Zombot, complete with fireballs and an RV dispensary system. Of course, times change and he can no longer afford such a costly project, but he managed to settle with a smaller more compact version of his first ever evil project, now with more time manipulation to boot.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MODERN1_DESCRIPTION_H: The menacing monstrosity of the Modern Day.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannon can rain down imps past your defenses

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss put on a black coat of paint to impose a menacing image: that this ship would be the nightmare of every cargo ship full of plants unfortunate enough to be sailing by. Although, this has more to do with the excessive amount of black paint he stored below the deck that he had no idea what to do with.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE2_DESCRIPTION_H: The plant plundering privateer of the high seas, reemerged from the depths to terrorize once again!
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannon can rain down imps past your defenses

{FLAVOR}"Hoist the mizzenmast, batten down the hatches! 15 zombies on a dead man's boat, yo ho ho and a bucket of brains!" Dr. Zomboss had to admit he was really getting into this whole pirate thing. Though he never thought he'd be on a boat on a boat.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION_HE: The plant plundering privateer of the high seas.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}transforms into a fighter plane on final phase

{FLAVOR}Unlike Dr. Zomboss, General Camo doesn't have any fondness for giant robots as a strategy. He finds them too cumbersome and cost-inefficient, and while him using one would be seen as blasphemy due to his antediluvian style when it comes to conducting his attacks, General Camo has one secret rule that he's lived by from the moment he donned his first mask: the rule of cool is one to triumph all. And you best believe a giant robot vulture is as cool as it comes.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION_H: The great scourge of the skies.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imps from smokestack

{FLAVOR}Overtaking the position of a wealthy factory owner, Dr. Zomboss had easy access to all the materials and parts he needed to build the Loco-motive. Still having his blueprints for previous spider Zombots, Dr. Zomboss and his underpaid employees went to work, building a budget-friendly alternative to the usually expensive and draining production of one of his Zombots. Not out of a concern for the future prosperity of the workplace, but rather to grab more assets for himself to recover from his previous endeavor. Sure, he might be leaving the factory bankrupt after he leaves, but that's not going to cause any long-term problems, right?
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The derailer of defenses that's sure to bring the pain train.
ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"Developing plant zomboids in eerie mimicry of zombie life is well within the boundaries of human experience," Zoybean Pod insists with a calm, unvarying steadiness.
ZOYBEANPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Zoybean Pods grow from sprouts to full pods, then split open to release helpful plant "zomboids" which attack zombies.
